text:
arjun: Heads-up: premerge SAST for repo infra-service skipped and marked MISSING. release candidate RC-2026-04-05 is blocked on this. scanner returned 403 pulling artifacts, tagging @maria @davis.
maria: link to CI and log?
arjun: https://ci.redwood/runs/5621 snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n{\"error\":\"accessDenied\", \"serviceAccount\":\"scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"}
```
davis: that was my RBAC prune PR 2130 yesterday. I removed storage.objectViewer and repo read from scanner-sa to tighten scope. didn't realise the SAST harness pulled build artifacts from GCS.
arjun: product-security is asking whether the scanner ever performed any KMS decrypts. need KMS audit for key project:redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build-key around 2026-04-05T07:30Z.
ci-bot: build run 5621 referenced kms key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build-key.
security-bot: suggested query:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"ci\" AND timestamp>\"2026-04-05T06:30:00Z\"" --limit 200
```
anya: quick triage: if scanner-sa couldn't read artifacts, it couldn't have called KMS to unwrap tokens for those artifacts. still want logs to be thorough.
maria: short-term unblock plan: I'll add storage.objectViewer back to scanner-sa via auditable infra change, rerun SAST, then remove role with a signed JIRA documenting why.
davis: longer term we should mint ephemeral, least-privilege tokens that the scanner uses for a single run. we have the keystore API that can generate KMS-wrapped ephemeral creds; design RFC incoming. advantage: no long-lived SA perms and clear KMS unwrap events.
arjun: product-security wants specific telemetry: (1) KMS decrypt count per key per hour (alert if >5 unusual decrypts) (2) log retention 90 days for CI key audit entries (3) link decrypt events to the job/run id in logs.
security-bot: we can implement an alert rule: loggingMetric + alert policy on KMS protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\" with count aggregation. I'll add a draft.
maria: created INFSEC-2205: \"SAST harness missing due to RBAC prune\". attaching CI logs and the gcloud query command. assigning remediation to davis (ephemeral tokens) and presubmit gating to me. tagging @anya for KMS alert work.
scan-bot: rerun started: https://ci.redwood/runs/5622
scan-bot: SAST 5622 results: 0 HIGH, 2 MED, 5 LOW. full report: https://scans.redwood/5622.json
arjun: excellent. follow-ups captured on INFSEC-2205: (A) presubmit should treat MISSING as FAIL (i.e., block merge), (B) implement ephemeral KMS-wrapped scanner creds, (C) add KMS decrypt alert threshold and link to run IDs, (D) update RBAC change checklist to run automated scanner smoke test post-PR.
davis: I'll open RFC for ephemeral creds and reference the keystore unwrap flow. will include sample commands and the expected audit fields.
anya: I'll draft the KMS alert runbook and expected pager thresholds.
maria: I'll own the presubmit change and the short-term IAM rollback with an audit entry.
arjun: thanks all. marking release candidate unblocked and closing this thread; INFSEC-2205 will track the long-term items.
scan-bot: note attached to INFSEC-2205: CI logs + scan artifact + KMS query example.
maria: adding a blameless note to the release board and scheduling a 20-min follow-up to sync on the RFC.
arjun: closing thread — keep the ticket open until (A)-(D) done.
